build_youtube_vis_dataset: build a YoutubeVis dataset builder with custom config for video instance segmentation
create_youtube_vis_config: create a YoutubeVisConfig with height, width, and only_frames_with_labels options
build_annotations_index: build an annotations index mapping video IDs to track annotations and videos
create_per_track_annotation: create per-track annotation with bboxes, segmentations, and areas for a video track
decode_segmentation: decode run-length encoded segmentation into a resized image array
